sourceOfTruthNote: The catalogue remains the design source of truth for the full six-phase expansion. A first Ferravium processing source prototype now exists in native C++ and source assets; natural world nodes, editor import, runtime schematic wiring and game validation remain pending.

progression.gating: Complete the new Elevator phase before the associated terminal research chapter becomes available.

phases.title: Frontier Survey
phases.subtitle: Průzkum hranic
phases.requires: Vanilla Space Elevator Phase V complete
phases.summary: Ferravium, průzkum ložisek, první endgame vybavení, zbraň a Blueprint Designer Mk4.

phases.title: Advanced Metallurgy
phases.subtitle: Pokročilá metalurgie
phases.summary: Titanové slitiny, těžká výroba, Mk7 logistika, automatická obrana a Exosuit.

phases.title: Cryogenic Systems
phases.subtitle: Kryogenní systémy

phases.title: Photonic Manufacturing
phases.subtitle: Fotonická výroba

phases.title: Gravitic Engineering

phases.subtitle: Meziplanetární logistika
phases.summary: Orbitální logistika, kvantové relé, vzdálená správa továren, pokročilý blueprint management a podpůrný systém.

balanceTargets.note: All new capacities, dimensions, durations and quantities are proposed targets. They require engine and gameplay validation; do not hard-code as proven Satisfactory limits.

implementationConstraints: Blueprint Designer Mk1, Mk2 and Mk3 already exist in vanilla; this expansion starts with Mk4.
New ore nodes in the vanilla World Partition map require a supported placement path; the current public modding toolkit documents World Partition interaction as unavailable.
A dynamically spawned resource node must be added to the resource scanner's internal node clusters after spawn.
New weapons and equipment must use valid native equipment descriptors, ammo, damage, inventory and multiplayer replication paths.
Defensive AI, drones, remote factory control and quantum cargo transfer are higher-risk features and need dedicated technical prototypes.
Do not ship invented vanilla item class paths; resolve all vanilla dependencies from the target game's asset registry before content packaging.

The final designed chain remains separate: Titan Alloy Ingot -> Industrial Press -> Titan Alloy Beam. The dedicated Advanced Alloy Foundry, Industrial Press and remaining Phase II buildings are not implemented.
